[b]The Republic shall reign![/b]

[spoiler=Political System][i]With the short-term mandate of the interim government coming to an end, the new Nevonia had to take its place as a democratic republic. A new system of government that represents the will of the people, honors the rule of law, and respects the rights of all Nevonians would have to be built from the ground up and last forever. The Interim Government, along with local leaders, the Nevonian Self Defense Force, experts, and foreign observers, started discussing the future of Nevonia and the formation of a just system of government for all Nevonians. The Interim Government would write a new constitution that truly represents the people of Nevonia. For the political system, a parliamentary system was decided upon. The new legislature would be unicameral with the sole chamber being called the Folksried or People's Council. The Folksried is made up of 379 seats, with 50 seats being allocated to the Republican Front, National Homeland Movement, and Women's Republican Defense Unit, as they were the main paramilitaries who fought against the previous royalist regime. The Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia was not directly allocated seats, as they chose to form a proper political party. The remaining 329 seats were to be elected by the people. 16 multi member constuencies would be established across the nation, with each having seats that were filled via proportional representation. For the proportionally elected seats, there is an electoral threshold of 5% of the popular vote, but parties representing a national minority have a threshold of 1% of the popular vote.[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=Announcement of Elections][i]Interim Prime Minister Wiber Heeringa made a national address on the steps of the Maaiefjild City Hall that was broadcasted accross Nevonia.[/i]

[b]Interim Prime Minister Wiber Heeringa:[/b][i]"Citizens of Nevonia, with a new era upon us, we must begin planning for the future. Within the Interim Government, we have had meaningful discussions and have begun planning the transition to a government by the people for the people. So, to all the people of Nevonia, I am proud to announce that on Tuesday, the 1st of February the first elections to the Folksried will be held. All Nevonians will have the right to vote and I urge all Nevonians to vote."[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The Campaign][i]As soon as the elections were announced, political parties started campaigning immediately. While a total of 9 parties would contest the election it was clear there were 3 front-runners; the Folksfront foar de befrijing fan Nevonia (FBN) or Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia led by Interim Minister of Foreign Affairs Simen Kramer, Nije Demokracy (ND) or New Democracy led by former Republican Front general Hokke Zijlstra and the Lusandryske Demokratyske Uny (LDU) or Lusandrian Democratic Union led by former professor Angela Mellor. The FBN, ND and LDU were seen by journalist as the biggest competitors to form a government. However even the parties seen as fringe parties contested the elections. The campaigned was very much focused on reconstruction, economic growth and development. The FBN stressed a message of decreasing income inequality and a republic by and for the people, while the ND called for more economic liberalism to allow for business growth, and the LDU campaigned on more fiscal responsibility but also stressing Lusandrian conservative values. Across the country, the leaders of the parties pushed on hard to gain support from the people. Leader of the Demokratyske Boerenliga (DB) or Democratic Farmers League, Klasje Klaver visited rural farming villages in the north east of the country that were devestated during the war, Klaver pledged that the DB would give farmers more opportunities and build a strong agricultural industry. Alex Wijnkoop the leader of the Frije Libertaryske Partij (FLP) or Free Libertarian Party, made it clear that making the new Nevonia a free republic for liberty for all Nevonians and stressing a less powerful government. Former enviormentalist lawyer Rudolph Nadar, the leader of the Griene Partij (GP) or Green Party focused on having a strong and healthy nation fueled by carbon-neutral energy. While Unkrûdblok (UB) or Weed Bloc leader Mary Willson called for legalized marijuana and less regulations on drugs. As the campaign came to an end the parties made their final messages to voters.[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The election itself][i]As election day arrived despite the cold wintry weather millions of Nevonia went out to vote for the very first time in Nevonia's history. The Republican Electoral Board announced that there was a voter turnout of 76.3%. During the evening radio and TV stations broadcasted coverage and millions of people tuned in to watch results come in live. As the night grew, it was projected that Simen Kramer and the Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia had won an absolute majority of seats.[/i]

[b]Results[/b]
[list]
Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia (FBN): 210 seats
New Democracy (ND): 61 seats
Free Libertarian Party (FLP): 29 seats
Lusandrian Democratic Union (LDU): 17 seats
Flouschian People's Association of Nevonia (FVVN): 6 seats
Democratic Farmers League (DB): 3 seats
Humanist Progress Party (HFP): 3 seats
[/list]

[i]The results concluded with the FBN winning in a landslide victory while ND underperformed. The LDU massively underperformed expectations, with the FLP doing much better than expected. The GP and UB did not manage to win any seats.[/i]

[i]It was clear that FBM had a huge advantage being one of the main republican paramillitaries during the war. Many voters had high approval of them as they one of the largest forces that ended the royalist regime. Accross the nation the FBN had large victories even in local elections. Voters had faith in the FBN to continue reconstruction and improve the way of life for millions of Nevonians.[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=Victory for the FBN][i]At the FBN headquarters in Maaiefjild where a party was being held the moment that networks projected an FBN victory, loud cheers and chants rang out. General Secretary Simen Kramer soon walked onto a stage where he was greeted by a thunderous round of appluase that lasted 2 miniutes straight. Along with Kramer on stage was his wife Weartsje, his children Karst and Sieneke and Deputy Secretary Yft Bleeker. Bleeker first a gave a short speech where he thanked the people for voting for the FBN and praised Kramer for his leadership during the war and now during the campaign. Bleeker then introduced Kramer and Kramer walked up to the podium. As Kramer walked up to the podium more loud applause rang out. After the appluase of the crowd, Kramer began his speech.[/i]

[b]General Secretary Simen Kramer:[/b][i]"My fellow Nevonians - the people of Nevonia. This is indeed an amazing night. Shortly ago the results of this election were announced, and I am delighted by the overwhelming support for the Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia. To all those in the Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia and the republican movement who worked so hard this campaign and through our struggle during the war, I thank you and honor you. To the people of Nevonia and the world who are watching: this a joyous night for the republican spirit. This is your victory too. You helped end the royalist regime, you stood with us during the opression. You were there for us during the war for our freedom. I watched, along with all of you, as millions of Nevonia stood patiently in long queues for many hours. Some sleeping on the open ground overnight waiting to cast this momentous vote. Nevonia's heroes are legend across the generations. But it is you, the people, who are our true heroes. This is one of the most important moments in the life of our country. I stand here before you filled with deep pride an joy: - pride in the brave, humble people of this struggle. You have shown such a brave and chaotic determination to building this new republic. I stand before you humbled by your courage, with a heart full of love for all of you. I regard it as the highest honour to lead the Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia at this moment in our history, and that we have been chosen to lead our country into the new century. This is your moment of victory and the moment where the shackles of royalist end. THE REPUBLIC SHALL REIGN!"[/i][/spoiler]
